regex: ^所有距离和速度以体长（BL）为单位：每只鼠的体长为行走时（0\.7–4\ BL/s、与另一只鼠相距\ >\ 2\ BL）颈到尾根距离的中位数（resident\ ([\s\S]*?)\ ([\s\S]*?)，intruder\ ([\s\S]*?)\ ([\s\S]*?)）；两鼠间距除以平均体长。相对速度为两鼠速度向量之差的模。$
translation: All distances and speeds are in body lengths (BL): each mouse's body length is its median neck → tail base distance while walking (0.7–4 BL/s, > 2 BL from the other mouse) (resident {0} {1}, intruder {2} {3}); inter-animal distances are divided by the mean body length. Relative speed is the magnitude of the difference of the two velocity vectors.
source: 所有距离和速度以体长（BL）为单位：每只鼠的体长为行走时（0.7–4 BL/s、与另一只鼠相距 > 2 BL）颈到尾根距离的中位数（resident {0} {1}，intruder {2} {3}）；两鼠间距除以平均体长。相对速度为两鼠速度向量之差的模。

regex: ^攻击：身体中心距离\ <\ ([\s\S]*?)\ BL（或重叠成一个检测），且\ 0\.33\ s\ 窗口内平均速度\ >\ ([\s\S]*?)\ BL/s、相对速度\ >\ ([\s\S]*?)\ BL/s\ 或体轴角速度\ >\ ([\s\S]*?)°/s，持续\ ≥\ ([\s\S]*?)\ s；不区分发起者。扭打为攻击中两鼠都在动、整体位移速度\ <\ 平均速度一半、持续\ ≥\ ([\s\S]*?)\ s\ 的部分。$
translation: Attack: body-center distance < {0} BL (or the mice merged into one detection) with, in a 0.33 s window, mean speed > {1} BL/s and relative speed > {2} BL/s or body-axis rotation > {3}°/s, lasting ≥ {4} s; the initiator is not judged. Clinch is the part of an attack where both mice move while the pair moves at < half their mean speed, lasting ≥ {5} s.
source: 攻击：身体中心距离 < {0} BL（或重叠成一个检测），且 0.33 s 窗口内平均速度 > {1} BL/s、相对速度 > {2} BL/s 或体轴角速度 > {3}°/s，持续 ≥ {4} s；不区分发起者。扭打为攻击中两鼠都在动、整体位移速度 < 平均速度一半、持续 ≥ {5} s 的部分。

regex: ^追逐：resident\ 速度\ >\ ([\s\S]*?)\ BL/s、intruder\ 速度\ >\ ([\s\S]*?)\ BL/s，resident\ 朝\ intruder\ 移动、intruder\ 沿同一方向远离，间距\ 0\.5–5\ BL，持续\ ≥\ ([\s\S]*?)\ s。压制：两鼠贴近，resident\ 关键点清楚可见而\ intruder\ 的关键点被遮挡且几乎不动，持续\ ≥\ ([\s\S]*?)\ s，且在攻击或追逐结束后\ 5\ s\ 内开始。$
translation: Chase: resident speed > {0} BL/s and intruder speed > {1} BL/s, the resident moving toward the intruder and the intruder moving away in the same direction, 0.5–5 BL apart, lasting ≥ {2} s. Keep down: mice in contact, the resident's keypoints clearly visible while the intruder's are occluded and it barely moves, lasting ≥ {3} s and starting within 5 s after an attack or chase.
source: 追逐：resident 速度 > {0} BL/s、intruder 速度 > {1} BL/s，resident 朝 intruder 移动、intruder 沿同一方向远离，间距 0.5–5 BL，持续 ≥ {2} s。压制：两鼠贴近，resident 关键点清楚可见而 intruder 的关键点被遮挡且几乎不动，持续 ≥ {3} s，且在攻击或追逐结束后 5 s 内开始。

regex: ^侧身威胁：resident\ 体轴与两鼠连线成\ 55–125°，以侧向为主朝\ intruder\ 移动，间距\ 0\.5–2\.4\ BL，持续\ ≥\ ([\s\S]*?)\ s。直立：颈到尾根距离\ <\ ([\s\S]*?)\ ×\ 体长、身体中心几乎不动、面向近处的另一只鼠，持续\ ≥\ 0\.3\ s（resident\ 记为攻击性直立，intruder\ 记为防御性直立）。骑跨：两鼠体轴同向（<\ 35°），resident\ 位于\ intruder\ 后上方，持续\ ≥\ ([\s\S]*?)\ s。$
translation: Lateral threat: resident body axis at 55–125° to the line between the mice, moving mainly sideways toward the intruder, 0.5–2.4 BL apart, lasting ≥ {0} s. Upright: neck → tail base distance < {1} × body length, body center nearly still, facing the other mouse at close range, lasting ≥ 0.3 s (aggressive upright for the resident, defensive upright for the intruder). Mounting: body axes aligned (< 35°), the resident behind and over the intruder, lasting ≥ {2} s.
source: 侧身威胁：resident 体轴与两鼠连线成 55–125°，以侧向为主朝 intruder 移动，间距 0.5–2.4 BL，持续 ≥ {0} s。直立：颈到尾根距离 < {1} × 体长、身体中心几乎不动、面向近处的另一只鼠，持续 ≥ 0.3 s（resident 记为攻击性直立，intruder 记为防御性直立）。骑跨：两鼠体轴同向（< 35°），resident 位于 intruder 后上方，持续 ≥ {2} s。

translation: Sniffing: nose to the other mouse's nose or tail base < {0} BL, excluding attacks. Following: both mice moving (> 0.4 BL/s), the resident moving toward the intruder, < 2.7 BL apart, lasting ≥ 0.5 s, and not a chase.
source: 嗅探：鼻尖到对方鼻尖或尾根 < {0} BL，不含打斗时段；跟随：两鼠都在移动（> 0.4 BL/s）、resident 朝 intruder 移动、间距 < 2.7 BL，持续 ≥ 0.5 s，且不属于追逐。

translation: A choice is recorded when the animal moves from the start arm through a choice point (radius {0} cm) into the left or right arm. IdPhi sums absolute head-direction changes, is z-scored within session, and zIdPhi ≥ {1} is labeled VTE.
